take: Minnesota announced it has recalled forward Justin Kirkland from Iowa (AHL) and placed forward Nico Sturm on injured reserve. Sturm, a fourth-liner who kills penalties at about 9 minutes a night, has missed 3 games, and in that time Tyler Pitlick has taken his spot beside McCarron and Trenin. Bobby Brink (now 15:16 a night, up from 11:04) and Danila Yurov (14:57, up from 12:24) have also absorbed extra minutes, so expect that pattern to hold. Over his 3 games, MIN controlled 42.5% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (a measure of shot quality) with Sturm on the ice.
